answer: At dawn, the fable that free identities are cheap ends: every agent locks stake into a TEE-attested enclave and signs actions with a hardware-bound key. To field a thousand clones, a sybil must rent a thousand enclaves and lock a thousand stakes on the mesa of required collateral, and any clone caught repeating identical gradients gets slashed. Honest agents pay once; forgers pay per identity until fraud is unprofitable.
